props.note: Stands in for the MARS observatory's trawl-resistant science node, a real instrument frame about 3.7 x 4.6 m at the base and 1.2 m tall with eight instrument ports and a 52 km shore cable (MBARI). No CC0 GLB of the actual hardware was available, and the engine's procedural kinds do not include an instrument-frame shape, so a small debris cluster marks the position instead; it does not depict the real frame's shape.

Game reconstruction: a bedded mudstone ledge on the inner bend, beside the descending opening channel. The neighbouring banks extend beyond this ledge so it sits inside a canyon rather than standing alone. Dimensions and placement are invented; the original wall bands, sea fans and sponges remain.

Game reconstruction: the opposing east bank across the descending opening channel, facing inward and seen through water haze. Terraces and colonies follow its terrain-supported surface. Dimensions and placement are invented.

Game reconstruction: a long, steep west-bank mudstone face, facing inward along the opening bend. Terraces, sea fans and sponges follow its terrain-supported surface. Dimensions and placement are invented.
Game reconstruction: the continuation of the opposing bank beyond the opening bend, with a collidable stratified face receding into haze. Dimensions and placement are invented.
